What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

Part 1 gave the PDE and the element; this part turns them into numbers. The Galerkin weighted residual and integration by parts give [k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b}; the element matrices are evaluated in closed form, assembled through a connectivity table, the known temperatures are imposed, and the text’s plate is solved by hand and checked against a refined mesh. Plane stress reuses every one of these steps with two unknowns per node.Part 1 memberi PDE dan element; bahagian ini menukarkannya kepada nombor. Galerkin weighted residual dan integration by parts memberi [k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b}; matrix element dinilai dalam closed form, di-assemble melalui connectivity table, temperature yang diketahui dikenakan, dan plat dalam teks diselesaikan secara tangan dan disemak dengan mesh yang di-refine. Plane stress menggunakan semula setiap langkah ini dengan dua unknown setiap node.

After this part you should be able toSelepas bahagian ini, anda sepatutnya boleh

  1. Apply the Galerkin weighted residual method and integration by parts to obtain [k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b} and explain what each term means.Menggunakan Galerkin weighted residual method dan integration by parts untuk memperoleh [k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b} dan menerangkan maksud setiap term.
  2. Evaluate the conductance matrix [k] and the load vectors {q} and {b} of a 4-node rectangular element in closed form.Menilai conductance matrix [k] dan load vector {q} dan {b} bagi 4-node rectangular element dalam closed form.
  3. Assemble element matrices into the global system with a connectivity table and impose Dirichlet conditions by row–column elimination.Meng-assemble matrix element ke dalam sistem global dengan connectivity table dan mengenakan Dirichlet condition melalui row–column elimination.
  4. Solve a small problem by hand, post-process temperature and flux at a point, and judge the result against a refined mesh.Menyelesaikan masalah kecil secara tangan, post-process temperature dan flux pada satu titik, dan menilai hasilnya berbanding mesh yang di-refine.

1. Galerkin and integration by partsGalerkin dan integration by parts

≈ 9 min

Substitute the approximation T = {N}{T̂}ᵀ of Part 1 into the PDE and it does not balance: a bilinear field cannot satisfy a second-order equation at every point. The residual is what is left over. Four unknowns T̂1…T̂4, one equation, and it holds nowhere exactly.Gantikan approximation T = {N}{T̂}ᵀ dari Part 1 ke dalam PDE dan ia tidak seimbang: field bilinear tidak mampu memenuhi persamaan peringkat kedua pada setiap titik. Residual ialah apa yang tinggal. Empat unknown T̂1…T̂4, satu persamaan, dan ia tidak dipenuhi dengan tepat di mana-mana.

(2.34)
Galerkin’s ideaIdea GalerkinAsk instead that the residual be zero on average, weighted by each shape function in turn. Four weights, four equations. Galerkin chooses the weights equal to the shape functions, which makes [k] symmetric.Minta pula supaya residual itu sifar secara purata, di-weight oleh setiap shape function bergilir-gilir. Empat weight function, empat persamaan. Galerkin memilih weight function sama dengan shape function, dan itulah yang menjadikan [k] simetri.
(2.35)

Integration by parts: the 1D case you knowIntegration by parts: kes 1D yang anda kenal

For the bar element earlier in the course, one derivative moved from T onto the weight and a boundary term appeared:Bagi bar element pada awal kursus, satu derivative berpindah dari T kepada weight function dan satu boundary term muncul:

  • Purpose 1 · relax continuity. After the integration by parts only first derivatives of N and T appear, so a bilinear T is admissible. Its second derivatives would be zero or undefined at element edges.Tujuan 1 · melonggarkan continuity. Selepas integration by parts hanya derivative pertama N dan T yang muncul, jadi T bilinear boleh diterima. Derivative keduanya akan sifar atau tak tertakrif di tepi element.
  • Purpose 2 · expose the natural condition. The boundary term contains k ∂T/∂n, the flux. Where the flux is specified it becomes a load; where it is zero it vanishes; where T is specified the term is removed with the equation.Tujuan 2 · mendedahkan natural condition. Boundary term mengandungi k ∂T/∂n, iaitu flux. Di mana flux ditetapkan ia menjadi load; di mana ia sifar ia lenyap; di mana T ditetapkan term itu dibuang bersama persamaannya.

Two dimensions: Green’s theoremDua dimensi: teorem Green

The same move in two dimensions is Green’s theorem: the area integral of a derivative becomes a boundary integral minus an area integral with the derivative on the weight.Langkah yang sama dalam dua dimensi ialah teorem Green: integral luas bagi satu derivative menjadi integral sempadan tolak integral luas dengan derivative pada weight function.

(2.36)

TermTermNameNamaWhat it holdsApa yang dikandunginya
[k]conductance matrixconductance matrixthe material and the geometry of the element; symmetric; 4 × 4bahan dan geometri element; simetri; 4 × 4
{q}source vectorsource vectorthe heat generated inside the element, shared among its nodeshaba yang dijana di dalam element, dikongsi antara node-nya
{b}boundary vectorboundary vectorthe heat entering through edges with a known flux; zero on insulated edges; discarded with the equation on Dirichlet edgeshaba yang masuk melalui tepi dengan flux diketahui; sifar pada tepi insulated; dibuang bersama persamaan pada tepi Dirichlet
Which edges contribute to {b}?Tepi mana yang menyumbang kepada {b}?For the text’s plate (top and left at 0 °C, right and bottom insulated): none. The insulated edges have qb = 0, and on the two Dirichlet edges the unknown flux multiplies the Ni of nodes whose equations we discard when T is imposed. The flux there can be recovered afterwards, like a support reaction.Bagi plat dalam teks (atas dan kiri pada 0 °C, kanan dan bawah insulated): tiada. Tepi insulated ada qb = 0, dan pada dua tepi Dirichlet flux yang tidak diketahui mendarab Ni bagi node yang persamaannya kita buang apabila T dikenakan. Flux di situ boleh diperoleh semula kemudian, seperti support reaction.
Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Galerkin: weighted residual with the shape functions as weights; integration by parts lowers the derivative order and exposes the natural condition.Galerkin: weighted residual dengan shape function sebagai weight function; integration by parts merendahkan peringkat derivative dan mendedahkan natural condition.
  • [k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b} = {r}: conductance matrix, source vector, boundary vector.[k]{T̂}ᵀ = {q} + {b} = {r}: conductance matrix, source vector, boundary vector.
  • One 4-node element gives 4 equations; the 2 × 2 mesh gives 9, and 4 remain after T is imposed on 5 nodes.Satu 4-node element memberi 4 persamaan; mesh 2 × 2 memberi 9, dan 4 tinggal selepas T dikenakan pada 5 node.

2. The element matrix and the load vectorsMatrix element dan load vector

≈ 10 min

The matrix product inside [k] is best read from the inside out. Take the entry k34: shape function 3 on the left, shape function 4 on the right, and the operator acting on each.Hasil darab matrix di dalam [k] paling mudah dibaca dari dalam ke luar. Ambil entri k34: shape function 3 di kiri, shape function 4 di kanan, dan operator bertindak ke atas setiap satu.

k₃₄ in four symbolic steps (text (2.43)–(2.46))k₃₄ dalam empat langkah simbolik (teks (2.43)–(2.46))

Each operator acts on the shape function to its left (from the integration by parts) or to its right. The result is a sum of two products of derivatives, one weighted by kx and one by ky.Setiap operator bertindak ke atas shape function di kirinya (daripada integration by parts) atau di kanannya. Hasilnya ialah hasil tambah dua hasil darab derivative, satu di-weight oleh kx dan satu lagi oleh ky.

Step 5: the integrals (text (2.47)–(2.48))Langkah 5: integral (teks (2.47)–(2.48))

(2.48)

The whole matrix in four numbersKeseluruhan matrix dalam empat nombor

Repeat the same integration for the other entries and only four distinct values appear. [k] is symmetric and has the pattern below.Ulang integration yang sama untuk entri lain dan hanya empat nilai berbeza yang muncul. [k] simetri dan mempunyai pola di bawah.

(2.49)
Row-sum checkSemakan jumlah bariss1 + s2 + s3 + s4 = 0 for every a, b, kx, ky: a uniform temperature conducts no heat. Add up any row of a matrix you compute; if it is not zero, look for the slip.s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 = 0 bagi setiap a, b, kx, ky: temperature seragam tidak mengalirkan haba. Jumlahkan mana-mana baris matrix yang anda kira; jika bukan sifar, cari kesilapannya.
The usual trapPerangkap biasab/a and a/b swapped. In s2 and s4 the kx term carries b/a (the two nodes of a horizontal side) and the ky term a/b. For a square the matrix depends only on k, not on the side.b/a dan a/b tertukar. Dalam s2 dan s4, term kx membawa b/a (dua node pada sisi mendatar) dan term ky membawa a/b. Bagi segi empat sama, matrix bergantung pada k sahaja, bukan pada sisinya.

The load vectorsLoad vector

A uniform source is shared equally among the four nodes, because every Ni has the same integral ab/4 over the element. A uniform inward flux on an edge is shared equally by the two nodes of that edge, because along the edge only their shape functions are non-zero and each integrates to half the length.Source yang seragam dikongsi sama rata antara empat node, kerana setiap Ni mempunyai integral yang sama ab/4 di atas element. Flux ke dalam yang seragam pada satu tepi dikongsi sama rata oleh dua node tepi itu, kerana di sepanjang tepi hanya shape function mereka yang bukan sifar dan setiap satu ber-integral kepada separuh panjang.

In the 2 × 2 mesh, how many element matrices contribute to K25 (nodes 2 and 5)?Dalam mesh 2 × 2, berapa banyak matrix element yang menyumbang kepada K25 (node 2 dan 5)?

Node 5 alone is in four elements, but a coupling counts only the elements that contain both nodes.Node 2 dan 5 kedua-duanya dalam element 1 dan 2 (berkongsi sisi 2–5), jadi dua matrix ditambah: K25 = k23 + k14 = 2s4. Impose the known temperaturesKenakan temperature yang diketahui

A known T̄k is not an unknown, so its equation is not needed and its column multiplies a known number. Move that column times T̄k to the right-hand side, then delete the row and the column. Here all five known values are zero, so nothing moves to the right and the reduced system is simply rows and columns 2, 3, 5, 6.T̄k yang diketahui bukan unknown, jadi persamaannya tidak diperlukan dan lajurnya mendarab nombor yang diketahui. Pindahkan lajur itu kali T̄k ke sebelah kanan, kemudian buang baris dan lajur itu. Di sini kelima-lima nilai yang diketahui ialah sifar, jadi tiada yang berpindah ke kanan dan sistem terkurang hanyalah baris dan lajur 2, 3, 5, 6.

The column multiplies a known value, so its product Kik × 100 is a known number in every remaining equation and moves to the right-hand side. Only when the prescribed value is zero does nothing move. Option (c) is a valid computer trick but is not the hand method of this course.Lajur itu mendarab nilai yang diketahui, jadi hasil darabnya Kik × 100 ialah nombor yang diketahui dalam setiap persamaan yang tinggal dan berpindah ke sebelah kanan. Hanya apabila nilai yang ditetapkan ialah sifar, tiada yang berpindah. Pilihan (c) ialah helah komputer yang sah tetapi bukan kaedah tangan kursus ini.

5. Post-processing and accuracyPost-processing dan ketepatan

≈ 9 min

The solution is a list of nodal values. Everything else — the temperature at a point, the flux, the hottest spot — is post-processing with the shape functions of Part 1, done one element at a time in that element’s local coordinates.Penyelesaian ialah senarai nilai node. Segala yang lain — temperature pada satu titik, flux, titik paling panas — ialah post-processing dengan shape function Part 1, dibuat satu element pada satu masa dalam koordinat local element itu.

Temperature at any point: three stepsTemperature pada mana-mana titik: tiga langkah

  1. Find the element that contains the point.Cari element yang mengandungi titik itu.
  2. Convert to local coordinates: subtract the element’s origin (its local node 1).Tukar kepada koordinat local: tolak origin element (node local 1-nya).
  3. Evaluate N1…N4 there and multiply by the element’s nodal temperatures, in local order from the connectivity table.Nilaikan N1…N4 di situ dan darab dengan nodal temperature element itu, mengikut susunan local daripada connectivity table.

Worked example · T at (0.3, 0.2) (Activity 6, the assignment pattern)Contoh bekerja · T pada (0.3, 0.2) (Aktiviti 6, pola tugasan)

Element 1 has node 1 at the origin, so local = global here. For the point (0.8, 0.2) the element would be 2, with local (0.3, 0.2) — the same N — but the nodal values {T2, T3, T6, T5}.Element 1 mempunyai node 1 pada origin, jadi local = global di sini. Bagi titik (0.8, 0.2) element-nya ialah 2, dengan local (0.3, 0.2) — N yang sama — tetapi nilai node {T2, T3, T6, T5}.

Flux at a pointFlux pada satu titik

At the centroid of element 2 the flux has equal and opposite components: heat flows towards −x (the cold left edge) and +y (the cold top edge). Evaluate the flux at centroids or Gauss points; it is least accurate at nodes and jumps across element edges.Pada centroid element 2, flux mempunyai komponen yang sama dan bertentangan: haba mengalir ke arah −x (tepi kiri sejuk) dan +y (tepi atas sejuk). Nilaikan flux pada centroid atau titik Gauss; ia paling kurang tepat pada node dan melompat merentasi tepi element.

6. The script, the assignment and what comes nextSkrip, tugasan dan apa yang seterusnya

≈ 5 min

The script is the pipeline in thirty lines. Read it against the seven steps and every block has a name.Skrip ini ialah pipeline dalam tiga puluh baris. Baca ia berpandukan tujuh langkah dan setiap blok ada namanya.

% Local conductance matrix (text §2.3.1)
a = L/Nx; b = H/Ny;
s1 = b*kx/(3*a) + a*ky/(3*b);
s2 = -b*kx/(3*a) + a*ky/(6*b);
s3 = -b*kx/(6*a) - a*ky/(6*b);
s4 = b*kx/(6*a) - a*ky/(3*b);
k = [s1 s2 s3 s4; s2 s1 s4 s3; s3 s4 s1 s2; s4 s3 s2 s1];
fQ = a*b*Q/4*[1; 1; 1; 1];        % heat generation
% Assembly by connectivity (conn(e,:) = global nodes of element e)
for e = 1:Ne,  c = conn(e,:);  K(c,c) = K(c,c) + k;  F(c) = F(c) + fQ;  end
% Essential conditions: known nodes removed, their columns moved to the right
free = setdiff(1:n, fixed);  T = zeros(n,1);  T(fixed) = Tbar;
T(free) = K(free,free) \ (F(free) - K(free,fixed)*T(fixed));
% Post-processing: element, local coordinates, interpolation
e = find_element(x, y);  xl = x - X(conn(e,1));  yl = y - Y(conn(e,1));
N = [(a-xl)*(b-yl), xl*(b-yl), xl*yl, yl*(a-xl)]/(a*b);  Tp = N*T(conn(e,:));
  • Lines 2–8: step 5, the element matrix and load from the closed-form s1…s4 of §2.Baris 2–8: langkah 5, matrix element dan load daripada s1…s4 closed-form dalam §2.
  • Line 10: step 6, assembly, one scatter-add per element.Baris 10: langkah 6, assembly, satu scatter-add setiap element.
  • Lines 12–13: step 6, the known temperatures moved to the right and struck; step 7, the backslash solve.Baris 12–13: langkah 6, temperature yang diketahui dipindahkan ke kanan dan dibuang; langkah 7, penyelesaian backslash.
  • Lines 15–16: §5, interpolation in local coordinates.Baris 15–16: §5, interpolation dalam koordinat local.
Try itCubaChange the mesh to 4 × 4 and compare T(1, 0) with the table of §5. Then set Q = 0 and T = 5 on the left and 100 on the right edge: every mesh must return a straight line.Tukar mesh kepada 4 × 4 dan bandingkan T(1, 0) dengan jadual §5. Kemudian tetapkan Q = 0 dan T = 5 di kiri dan 100 di tepi kanan: setiap mesh mesti memulangkan garis lurus.

  • (c) With T2 = T6 = 150 K from the solution, interpolate T at (x, y) = (1.4, 2.2) m.(c) Dengan T2 = T6 = 150 K daripada penyelesaian, interpolate T pada (x, y) = (1.4, 2.2) m.

Show the connectivity table, s1…s4 with a = 2 m, b = 3 m, and the local coordinates used in (c). Marks are for the method; state the convention you use for the source (per unit area, unit thickness). What comes nextApa yang seterusnya

Plane stress repeats every step of this part with two unknowns per node: [E] becomes 3 × 3, {∂} a 2 × 3 operator matrix, and [k] 8 × 8. Before that session, read text §3.1 and revise plane stress versus plane strain, Hooke’s law in 2D and the strain–displacement relations.Plane stress mengulang setiap langkah bahagian ini dengan dua unknown setiap node: [E] menjadi 3 × 3, {∂} matrix operator 2 × 3, dan [k] 8 × 8. Sebelum sesi itu, baca teks §3.1 dan ulang kaji plane stress berbanding plane strain, hukum Hooke dalam 2D dan hubungan strain–displacement.

The exact field is linear in x, and the bilinear element contains 1, x and y, so it reproduces that field exactly on any mesh. Example 1 · Conductance matrix and nodal loads of a square elementContoh 1 · Conductance matrix dan nodal load bagi element segi empat sama

Exam typeJenis soalan [k] of a Q4 element, two entries by integration, the rest by pattern; {b} for a boundary flux, {q} for a sourceUnitsUnit W, m, KSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Examples 8.2 and 8.3 (textbook Exercises 2.1–2.3)20 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanA square element of side 0.025 m and thickness 0.005 m has k = 450 W m−1 K−1. (a) Show the integration for k12 and k13 and complete [k] by the pattern of (2.49). (b) Determine the nodal loads for an inward heat flux of 106 W m−2 on its right side, 2–3, and (c) for an internal heat generation of 107 W m−3. (d) In an examination plate of unit thickness, an element 2 m wide and 3 m high carries a heat source Q = 20 W m−2; determine its load vector.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. kij is the heat that must be supplied at node i when node j is held 1 K above the others, all at 0 K. In a square it is negative for i ≠ j, because a hotter node j pushes heat towards node i and the supply at i must take it away. For a square with kx = ky the matrix depends only on k and t, not on the side. The heat entering or generated is shared by the nodes in proportion to how much each shape function covers: every Ni integrates to ab/4 over the element, and along a side only its two nodes have non-zero shape functions, each taking half.kij ialah haba yang mesti dibekalkan pada node i apabila node j ditahan 1 K lebih tinggi daripada yang lain, semuanya pada 0 K. Dalam segi empat sama ia negatif untuk i ≠ j, kerana node j yang lebih panas menolak haba ke arah node i dan bekalan di i mesti membawanya pergi. Bagi segi empat sama dengan kx = ky, matrix itu bergantung pada k dan t sahaja, bukan pada sisi. Haba yang masuk atau dijana dikongsi oleh node mengikut kadar liputan setiap shape function: setiap Ni ber-integral kepada ab/4 di atas element, dan di sepanjang satu sisi hanya dua node-nya mempunyai shape function bukan sifar, setiap satu mengambil separuh.

Plan. Derivatives of N1, N2, N3 → integrate k12, k13 → s1 to s4 → the pattern → row-sum check → (b) {b} on side 2–3 → (c) {q} → (d) the same with Q per unit area → totals as checks.

Answer. (a) [k] as above: s1 = 1.5, s2 = s4 = −0.375, s3 = −0.75 W K−1.

Step 7 (d) A source given per unit area(d) Source yang diberi per unit luas[2]

Q = 20 W m−2 is heat per unit area of the plate and already contains the thickness, so it is not multiplied by t:Q = 20 W m−2 ialah haba per unit luas plat dan sudah mengandungi ketebalan, jadi ia tidak didarab dengan t:

Answer. (b) 62.5 W at nodes 2 and 3. (c) 7.81 W at each node. (d) {r}1 = {30, 30, 30, 30}ᵀ W.
Pitfall · W m−2 or W m−3Perangkap · W m−2 atau W m−3A source per unit volume (W m−3) is multiplied by t. A source per unit area of the plate (W m−2), as in part (d), already contains the thickness: do not multiply again.Source per unit isi padu (W m−3) didarab dengan t. Source per unit luas plat (W m−2), seperti dalam bahagian (d), sudah mengandungi ketebalan: jangan darab lagi.
InterpretationTafsiranThe diagonal pair (1–3) is coupled twice as strongly as each side pair, −0.75 against −0.375 W K−1. For a side pair the two directions work against each other: in k12 the kx term is negative and the ky term positive; for a diagonal pair both are negative. Doubling the side of the square leaves [k] unchanged: the longer conduction path and the wider section cancel. Equal shares are a property of uniform loads; whatever the distribution, the loads must add up to the total heat, and that check catches a forgotten thickness or a misplaced factor of 2.Pasangan pepenjuru (1–3) digandingkan dua kali lebih kuat daripada setiap pasangan sisi, −0.75 berbanding −0.375 W K−1. Bagi pasangan sisi, dua arah itu bertentangan: dalam k12 term kx negatif dan term ky positif; bagi pasangan pepenjuru kedua-duanya negatif. Menggandakan sisi segi empat sama tidak mengubah [k]: laluan conduction yang lebih panjang dan keratan yang lebih lebar saling membatalkan. Bahagian sama rata ialah sifat load seragam; apa jua taburannya, load mesti berjumlah kepada jumlah haba, dan semakan itu menangkap ketebalan yang terlupa atau faktor 2 yang tersalah letak.

Exam typeJenis soalan assembly of a 2 × 2 mesh, essential and natural conditions, solution by symmetry, energy balanceUnitsUnit W, m, KSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 8.6 (textbook Exercise 2.4)20 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanThe square plate of the figure, 0.05 m by 0.05 m and 0.005 m thick, is divided into four equal elements. Its top and bottom are insulated, its left side is held at 400 K, and its right side receives an inward heat flux of 106 W m−2. With k = 450 W m−1 K−1, determine the temperature at node 5.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. The heat entering at the right side, 106(0.005)(0.05) = 250 W, must all leave through the left side; with the top and bottom insulated it flows straight across, so T depends on x only. With no source the gradient is constant, qn/k = 2222 K m−1, so expect T = 400 + 2222x: 455.6 K at the middle column and 511.1 K at the right side. A bilinear element contains this linear field, so the finite element solution should reproduce it.Haba yang masuk pada sisi kanan, 106(0.005)(0.05) = 250 W, mesti semuanya keluar melalui sisi kiri; dengan atas dan bawah insulated ia mengalir terus melintang, jadi T bergantung pada x sahaja. Tanpa source, gradient-nya malar, qn/k = 2222 K m−1, jadi jangkakan T = 400 + 2222x: 455.6 K pada lajur tengah dan 511.1 K pada sisi kanan. Element bilinear mengandungi field linear ini, jadi penyelesaian finite element sepatutnya menghasilkannya semula.

Plan. [k] of Example 1 → assemble 9 × 9 → flux loads at nodes 3, 6, 9 → strike nodes 1, 4, 7 → solve by columns → check a full row → energy balance.

The flux enters through sides 3–6 and 6–9, each giving 62.5 W to each of its nodes (Example 1):Flux masuk melalui sisi 3–6 dan 6–9, setiap satu memberi 62.5 W kepada setiap node-nya (Contoh 1):

Step 3 Boundary conditionsBoundary condition[3]

T1 = T4 = T7 = 400 K: strike rows and columns 1, 4, 7 and subtract Ki1(400) + Ki4(400) + Ki7(400) from the right-hand side. Six unknowns remain.T1 = T4 = T7 = 400 K: buang baris dan lajur 1, 4, 7 dan tolak Ki1(400) + Ki4(400) + Ki7(400) daripada sebelah kanan. Enam unknown tinggal.

Step 4 Solution by columnsPenyelesaian mengikut lajur[5]

Since T does not vary with y, the middle column shares one value and the right column another. Adding the three equations of the middle column (rows 2, 5, 8) and the three of the right column (rows 3, 6, 9):Oleh kerana T tidak berubah dengan y, lajur tengah berkongsi satu nilai dan lajur kanan satu nilai lain. Menambah tiga persamaan lajur tengah (baris 2, 5, 8) dan tiga persamaan lajur kanan (baris 3, 6, 9):

Check.

Answer. T5 = 455.6 K (and T2 = T8 = 455.6, T3 = T6 = T9 = 511.1 K).

Step 5 Energy balanceEnergy balance[4]

InterpretationTafsiranThe finite element temperatures equal the exact 400 + qnx/k at every node, as expected: the exact field is linear, and a bilinear element represents a linear field exactly. Two features of the data make the column shortcut valid, the insulated top and bottom and the uniform conditions on the left and right; with a flux on part of a side only, or a hole, T would vary with y and the six equations would have to be solved together. Doubling the thickness doubles both [K] and {R} and leaves the temperatures unchanged.
Temperature finite element sama dengan 400 + qnx/k yang tepat pada setiap node, seperti dijangka: field tepat adalah linear, dan element bilinear mewakili field linear dengan tepat. Dua ciri data menjadikan jalan pintas lajur itu sah, iaitu atas dan bawah yang insulated dan keadaan seragam di kiri dan kanan; dengan flux pada sebahagian sisi sahaja, atau satu lubang, T akan berubah dengan y dan enam persamaan itu perlu diselesaikan bersama. Menggandakan ketebalan menggandakan [K] dan {R} dan tidak mengubah temperature.

Example 3 · Plate with a heat source: the textbook’s worked exampleContoh 3 · Plat dengan heat source: contoh bekerja dalam teks

Exam typeJenis soalan 2 × 2 mesh, assembly, symmetry, energy balance, accuracyUnitsUnit W, m, °CSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 8.7 (textbook §2.3)20 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanThe square plate of the figure, 1 m by 1 m and of unit thickness, generates Q = 600 W m−3 and has k = 300 W m−1 °C−1. Its left and top edges are held at 0 °C; its bottom and right edges are insulated. With four equal Q4 elements, (a) form [k] and {r} of an element, (b) assemble, apply the boundary conditions and solve, and (c) check the energy balance and compare with the exact solution.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. The heat generated everywhere flows to the cold left and top edges, so the hottest point is the corner farthest from both, node 3 at (1, 0). The problem is symmetric about the diagonal through (0, 1) and (1, 0), so T2 = T6. The insulated edges are lines of symmetry: the plate is one quarter of a 2 m square with all edges at 0 °C, whose centre temperature is 0.07367 Q(2)²/k = 0.589 °C.Haba yang dijana di mana-mana mengalir ke tepi kiri dan atas yang sejuk, jadi titik paling panas ialah bucu paling jauh daripada kedua-duanya, node 3 pada (1, 0). Masalah ini simetri tentang pepenjuru melalui (0, 1) dan (1, 0), jadi T2 = T6. Tepi insulated ialah garis simetri: plat ini ialah satu perempat daripada segi empat sama 2 m dengan semua tepi pada 0 °C, yang temperature pusatnya 0.07367 Q(2)²/k = 0.589 °C.

Plan. s1 to s4, Qab/4 → assemble 9 × 9 → strike nodes 1, 4, 7, 8, 9 → T6 = T2 → 3 × 3 → heat flows → exact solution and convergence.

Answer. (c) Energy balance 600 W in and out; the 2 × 2 mesh is 5–7% high at its nodes, and the error falls about four times each time the mesh is halved.
InterpretationTafsiranThe error falls as h², the rate of bilinear elements for a smooth field, about four times for each halving of the mesh. Finite element temperatures are not bounds: the 2 × 2 Q4 mesh is above the exact values, while the textbook’s two eight-node elements give 0.4448 and 0.5836 °C, below them. The nodal temperatures are not exact here, as they were in Example 2, because the exact field is curved in both directions. Node 5 shows the averaging property of square meshes: 800T5 = 100(T1 + … + T9 without T5) + 150, the mean of its eight neighbours plus the effect of the source.Ralat jatuh sebagai h², kadar element bilinear bagi field yang licin, kira-kira empat kali bagi setiap pembahagian dua mesh. Temperature finite element bukan sempadan: mesh Q4 2 × 2 berada di atas nilai tepat, manakala dua element lapan node dalam teks memberi 0.4448 dan 0.5836 °C, di bawahnya. Nodal temperature tidak tepat di sini, tidak seperti dalam Contoh 2, kerana field tepat melengkung dalam kedua-dua arah. Node 5 menunjukkan sifat purata mesh segi empat sama: 800T5 = 100(T1 + … + T9 tanpa T5) + 150, min lapan jirannya ditambah kesan source.

"""
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - steady 2D heat conduction with 4-node elements
================================================================================

Companion code for the Heat Conduction Explorer (2D Heat Transfer, Part 2).
It follows the seven steps of the course, in the text's notation
(Mohd Yassin et al., MSNM 2020, Chapter 2):

    1-2  mesh of a rectangular plate, L x H, Nx x Ny four-node elements
    5    element matrix [k] from the closed-form s1...s4         text (2.49)
         source loads {q} = t Q ab/4 at each node                text (2.39)
         edge-flux loads {b} = t q_n l/2 at each edge node        text (2.40)
    6    assembly by the connectivity table (scatter-add),
         known temperatures by row-column elimination
    7    solve; heat flows at the fixed nodes (energy balance);
         temperature and heat flux at any point

Mesh and numbering
    Nodes are numbered left to right, then bottom to top, starting at 1 in
    the printout (the text's 2 x 2 mesh: nodes 1-3 along the bottom, 7-9 along
    the top). Element e has local nodes 1-4 anticlockwise from its bottom-left
    corner, e.g. element 1 of the 2 x 2 mesh = global nodes [1 2 5 4].

Units
    Any consistent set; the examples use m, W and degC (or K).
    Q is heat generated per unit VOLUME (W/m3) and is multiplied by t.
    A source given per unit AREA of the plate (W/m2) already contains the
    thickness: use t = 1 and Q = that value.
    q_n is the INWARD boundary flux (W/m2); an insulated edge has q_n = 0.

Run
    python fe_heat_q4.py
        reproduces the text's worked example (Sec. 2.3), its energy balance
        and mesh study, and the 2 x 2 plate with an inward flux; saves a
        contour plot if matplotlib is installed.

Use for your own problem: edit the block at the bottom, or
    from fe_heat_q4 import solve_plate, temperature_at
    res = solve_plate(L=4, H=2, Nx=4, Ny=2, kx=10, ky=10,
                      edges={"left": ("T", 50), "right": ("flux", 200),
                             "top": ("insulated",), "bottom": ("insulated",)},
                      Q=lambda xc, yc: 100 if xc < 1 else 0)  # source in the first column only
    print(res["K"])                     # compare with your hand assembly
    print(temperature_at(res, 1.4, 0.7))

A hand calculation is still a hand calculation: use this script to check your
matrices and numbers, and show the steps yourself.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plot.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 5: element matrix and loads
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def s_values(a, b, kx, ky):
    """The four distinct entries of [k] for an a x b rectangle, text (2.49)."""
    s1 = b * kx / (3 * a) + a * ky / (3 * b)
    s2 = -b * kx / (3 * a) + a * ky / (6 * b)
    s3 = -b * kx / (6 * a) - a * ky / (6 * b)
    s4 = b * kx / (6 * a) - a * ky / (3 * b)
    return s1, s2, s3, s4


def element_matrix(a, b, kx, ky, t=1.0):
    """Conductance matrix [k] (4 x 4, W/K). Every row adds up to zero."""
    s1, s2, s3, s4 = s_values(a, b, kx, ky)
    return t * np.array([[s1, s2, s3, s4],
                         [s2, s1, s4, s3],
                         [s3, s4, s1, s2],
                         [s4, s3, s2, s1]])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Steps 1-2: mesh
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mesh(L, H, Nx, Ny):
    """Node coordinates (n x 2) and connectivity (ne x 4, 0-based) of a structured mesh."""
    a, b = L / Nx, H / Ny
    nodes = np.array([(i * a, j * b) for j in range(Ny + 1) for i in range(Nx + 1)], dtype=float)
    conn = []
    for j in range(Ny):
        for i in range(Nx):
            n1 = j * (Nx + 1) + i
            conn.append([n1, n1 + 1, n1 + Nx + 2, n1 + Nx + 1])
    return a, b, nodes, np.array(conn, dtype=int)


def edge_nodes(nodes, L, H, edge, tol=1e-9):
    """Indices of the nodes on one edge of the plate, ordered along it."""
    x, y = nodes[:, 0], nodes[:, 1]
    if edge == "bottom":
        idx = np.where(abs(y) < tol)[0]; key = x
    elif edge == "top":
        idx = np.where(abs(y - H) < tol)[0]; key = x
    elif edge == "left":
        idx = np.where(abs(x) < tol)[0]; key = y
    elif edge == "right":
        idx = np.where(abs(x - L) < tol)[0]; key = y
    else:
        raise ValueError("edge must be bottom, right, top or left")
    return idx[np.argsort(key[idx])]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Steps 5-7: assemble, impose, solve, post-process
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_plate(L, H, Nx, Ny, kx, ky=None, edges=None, Q=0.0, t=1.0):
    """Solve a rectangular plate.

    edges: dict with keys "bottom", "right", "top", "left"; each value is
           ("T", value)  prescribed temperature (essential)
           ("flux", qn)  inward heat flux, W/m2 (natural)
           ("insulated",) zero flux (natural; nothing to do)
           A corner shared by two prescribed edges takes the value of the
           first in the order top, left, right, bottom.
    Q:     heat generated per unit volume, a number or a function Q(xc, yc)
           of the element centroid (for a source on some elements only).
    Returns a dict with the mesh, [K], {R}, the temperatures and the heat
    flows at the fixed nodes.
    """
    ky = kx if ky is None else ky
    edges = edges or {}
    a, b, nodes, conn = mesh(L, H, Nx, Ny)
    n = len(nodes)
    K = np.zeros((n, n))
    R = np.zeros(n)
    k = element_matrix(a, b, kx, ky, t)
    generated = 0.0
    for e, c in enumerate(conn):
        K[np.ix_(c, c)] += k                                   # scatter-add
        xc, yc = nodes[c].mean(axis=0)
        Qe = Q(xc, yc) if callable(Q) else Q
        R[c] += t * Qe * a * b / 4                             # {q}: equal shares
        generated += t * Qe * a * b
    flux_in = 0.0
    for name, bc in edges.items():
        if bc[0] == "flux":
            ids = edge_nodes(nodes, L, H, name)
            h = b if name in ("left", "right") else a
            for i0, i1 in zip(ids[:-1], ids[1:]):
                R[i0] += t * bc[1] * h / 2                     # {b}: half to each node of the side
                R[i1] += t * bc[1] * h / 2
                flux_in += t * bc[1] * h
    fixed = {}
    for name in ("top", "left", "right", "bottom"):
        bc = edges.get(name, ("insulated",))
        if bc[0] == "T":
            for i in edge_nodes(nodes, L, H, name):
                fixed.setdefault(int(i), float(bc[1]))
    if not fixed:
        raise ValueError("No edge has a prescribed temperature: [K] is singular "
                         "(the temperature level is undetermined).")
    known = np.array(sorted(fixed))
    Tbar = np.array([fixed[i] for i in known])
    free = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(n), known)
    T = np.zeros(n)
    T[known] = Tbar
    # row-column elimination: move K(:, known) * Tbar to the right, keep the free rows
    rhs = R[free] - K[np.ix_(free, known)] @ Tbar
    T[free] = np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(free, free)], rhs)
    heat = K[known] @ T - R[known]          # struck rows: heat supplied (+) or removed (-) there
    return dict(L=L, H=H, Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, a=a, b=b, kx=kx, ky=ky, t=t, nodes=nodes, conn=conn,
                K=K, R=R, T=T, known=known, free=free, heat=heat,
                generated=generated, flux_in=flux_in)


def locate(res, x, y):
    """Element containing the global point (x, y), and the local coordinates there."""
    a, b = res["a"], res["b"]
    i = min(res["Nx"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(x / a + 1e-12))))
    j = min(res["Ny"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(y / b + 1e-12))))
    e = j * res["Nx"] + i
    x1, y1 = res["nodes"][res["conn"][e][0]]
    return e, x - x1, y - y1


def temperature_at(res, x, y):
    """T and the heat flux (qx, qy) at a global point, from the element that contains it."""
    a, b = res["a"], res["b"]
    e, xl, yl = locate(res, x, y)
    Te = res["T"][res["conn"][e]]                       # nodal values in LOCAL order
    N = np.array([(a - xl) * (b - yl), xl * (b - yl), xl * yl, yl * (a - xl)]) / (a * b)
    dN = np.array([[-(b - yl), (b - yl), yl, -yl],
                   [-(a - xl), -xl, xl, (a - xl)]]) / (a * b)
    g = dN @ Te
    return dict(element=e + 1, local=(xl, yl), N=N, T=float(N @ Te),
                qx=float(-res["kx"] * g[0]), qy=float(-res["ky"] * g[1]))


def print_matrix(M, scale=1.0, name="[K]"):
    with np.printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=160):
        print(f"{name}" + (f" / {scale:g}" if scale != 1 else "") + " =")
        print(M / scale)


def plot_temperature(res, filename="temperature.png"):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    xs = np.linspace(0, res["L"], 121)
    ys = np.linspace(0, res["H"], max(31, int(121 * res["H"] / res["L"])))
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: temperature_at(res, x, y)["T"])(X, Y)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6 * res["H"] / res["L"] + 0.6))
    cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=21, cmap="jet")
    ax.contour(X, Y, Z, levels=10, colors="k", linewidths=0.5)
    for c in res["conn"]:
        p = res["nodes"][list(c) + [c[0]]]
        ax.plot(p[:, 0], p[:, 1], color="w", lw=0.8)
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("x (m)"); ax.set_ylabel("y (m)")
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=ax, label="T")
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # The text's worked example (Sec. 2.3): 1 m square, Q = 600 W/m3, k = 300,
    # top and left edges at 0 degC, right and bottom insulated, unit thickness.
    book = {"top": ("T", 0.0), "left": ("T", 0.0), "right": ("insulated",), "bottom": ("insulated",)}
    res = solve_plate(1, 1, 2, 2, 300, edges=book, Q=600)
    print("Text Sec. 2.3, 2 x 2 mesh")
    print("  element s1..s4 =", np.round(s_values(0.5, 0.5, 300, 300), 3), " (expected 200 -50 -100 -50)")
    print_matrix(res["K"], name="  [K]")
    print("  {R} =", res["R"])
    T = res["T"]
    print(f"  T2 = T6 = {T[1]:.4f}, T3 = {T[2]:.4f}, T5 = {T[4]:.4f} degC  (text (2.55): 0.4821, 0.6214, 0.3857)")
    print("  heat at fixed nodes", [int(i) + 1 for i in res["known"]], "=", np.round(res["heat"], 2), "W")
    print(f"  energy balance: generated {res['generated']:.1f} W, removed {-res['heat'].sum():.1f} W")
    p = temperature_at(res, 0.3, 0.2)
    print(f"  T(0.3, 0.2) = {p['T']:.4f} degC in element {p['element']}  (Activity 6: 0.266)")
    p = temperature_at(res, 0.75, 0.25)
    print(f"  flux at the centroid of element 2 = ({p['qx']:.1f}, {p['qy']:.1f}) W/m2  (-70.5, +70.5)")

    print("\nMesh study, T at the corner (1, 0); exact 0.5894 degC")
    prev = None
    for n in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
        r = solve_plate(1, 1, n, n, 300, edges=book, Q=600)
        tc = temperature_at(r, 1.0, 0.0)["T"]
        change = "" if prev is None else f"  change {100 * (tc - prev) / tc:+.2f} %"
        print(f"  {n:2d} x {n:<2d}  T = {tc:.4f}{change}")
        prev = tc

    # Companion Example 8.6 (textbook Exercise 2.4): 0.05 m square, t = 0.005 m, k = 450,
    # left side at 400 K, inward flux 1e6 W/m2 on the right, top and bottom insulated.
    res2 = solve_plate(0.05, 0.05, 2, 2, 450, t=0.005,
                       edges={"left": ("T", 400), "right": ("flux", 1e6), "top": ("insulated",), "bottom": ("insulated",)})
    print("\nPlate with an inward flux, 2 x 2 mesh")
    print(f"  T5 = {res2['T'][4]:.2f} K, T6 = {res2['T'][5]:.2f} K  (expected 455.56, 511.11)")
    print("  heat at nodes 1, 4, 7 =", np.round(res2["heat"], 2), "W; flux in =", res2["flux_in"], "W")

    plot_temperature(solve_plate(1, 1, 16, 16, 300, edges=book, Q=600), "temperature_16x16.png")

GlossaryGlosari

What to doApa perlu dibuat Look up a term; type in the box to filter. Terms stay in English in both languages; the explanation follows the language you chose.Cari istilah; taip dalam kotak untuk menapis. Istilah kekal dalam bahasa Inggeris dalam kedua-dua bahasa; penjelasan mengikut bahasa yang anda pilih.

Not counted toward progress.Tidak dikira dalam kemajuan.

residualWhat is left when the approximation is substituted into the PDE; zero only for the exact solution.Apa yang tinggal apabila approximation digantikan ke dalam PDE; sifar hanya untuk penyelesaian tepat.
weighted residualThe residual multiplied by a weight and integrated; set to zero to get one equation per weight.Residual didarab dengan weight function dan di-integrate; disamakan dengan sifar untuk mendapat satu persamaan setiap weight function.
Galerkin methodWeighted residual with the shape functions as weights; gives a symmetric [k].Weighted residual dengan shape function sebagai weight function; memberi [k] yang simetri.
integration by parts · Green’s theoremMoves one derivative from T onto the weight and produces a boundary term; in 2D the area integral trades with a boundary integral.Memindahkan satu derivative dari T kepada weight function dan menghasilkan boundary term; dalam 2D integral luas ditukar dengan integral sempadan.
weak formThe integrated, lower-derivative statement that the finite element equations come from.Pernyataan ter-integrate dengan derivative lebih rendah yang menjadi asal persamaan finite element.
conductance matrix [k]4 × 4, symmetric, from ∫{N}ᵀ{∂}[E]{∂}ᵀ{N} dA; the heat analogue of stiffness. Units W K−1 per unit thickness.4 × 4, simetri, daripada ∫{N}ᵀ{∂}[E]{∂}ᵀ{N} dA; analog haba bagi stiffness. Unit W K−1 per unit ketebalan.
s1…s4The four distinct entries of [k] for a rectangle, (2.49); s1 diagonal, s2 horizontal side, s4 vertical side, s3 diagonal pairs.Empat entri berbeza [k] bagi segi empat tepat, (2.49); s1 pepenjuru, s2 sisi mendatar, s4 sisi menegak, s3 pasangan pepenjuru.
source vector {q}Nodal loads from the heat generated inside the element, qhab/4 each for a uniform source.Nodal load daripada haba yang dijana di dalam element, qhab/4 setiap satu bagi source seragam.
boundary vector {b}Nodal loads from a known flux on an edge, qbℓ/2 at each of the two nodes of that edge.Nodal load daripada flux yang diketahui pada satu tepi, qbℓ/2 pada setiap satu daripada dua node tepi itu.
row-sum checkEvery row of [k] adds to zero because a uniform temperature conducts no heat.Setiap baris [k] berjumlah sifar kerana temperature seragam tidak mengalirkan haba.
connectivity tableFor each element, its global node numbers in local anticlockwise order.Bagi setiap element, nombor node global-nya mengikut susunan local lawan jam.
assembly · scatter-addKIJ += kij with I, J read from the connectivity table; the same for {R}.KIJ += kij dengan I, J dibaca daripada connectivity table; sama untuk {R}.
global system [K]{T} = {R}All elements assembled; singular until at least one temperature is prescribed.Semua element di-assemble; singular sehingga sekurang-kurangnya satu temperature ditetapkan.
row–column eliminationImposing a known T̄: move its column × T̄ to the right-hand side, delete the row and the column.Mengenakan T̄ yang diketahui: pindahkan lajurnya × T̄ ke sebelah kanan, buang baris dan lajur itu.
reduced systemThe equations that remain for the unknown temperatures after the known ones are struck.Persamaan yang tinggal untuk temperature yang tidak diketahui selepas yang diketahui dibuang.
struck rows · energy balanceRows of the known nodes, evaluated afterwards, give the heat flows there; their sum balances the heat put in.Baris node yang diketahui, dinilai selepas itu, memberi aliran haba di situ; jumlahnya mengimbangi haba yang dimasukkan.
local coordinatesPosition measured from an element’s local node 1; what Ni must be evaluated with.Kedudukan diukur dari node local 1 sesuatu element; itulah yang mesti digunakan untuk menilai Ni.
post-processingEverything computed from the nodal solution: T at a point, flux, hottest point, heat flows.Segala yang dikira daripada penyelesaian node: T pada satu titik, flux, titik paling panas, aliran haba.
mesh refinement · convergenceRepeating the solution on finer meshes until the answer stops changing; bilinear elements converge as h².Mengulang penyelesaian pada mesh yang lebih halus sehingga jawapan berhenti berubah; element bilinear converge sebagai h².
relative error(Tmesh − Tref)/Tref; about +5% for the 2 × 2 mesh of the text’s plate.(Tmesh − Tref)/Tref; kira-kira +5% bagi mesh 2 × 2 plat dalam teks.
patch testA field the element can represent exactly (here a linear T) must be reproduced exactly on any mesh.Field yang mampu diwakili element dengan tepat (di sini T linear) mesti dihasilkan semula dengan tepat pada mana-mana mesh.
symmetryEqual geometry, material, loads and boundary conditions about a line give equal temperatures at mirror nodes; a line of symmetry carries no heat across it.Geometri, bahan, load dan boundary condition yang sama tentang satu garis memberi temperature yang sama pada node cermin; garis simetri tidak membawa haba merentasinya.
